description: This file defines the 'Anr' class, which contains information about Application Not Responding (ANR) events captured in a bug report. It includes fields for process details, reason, CPU usage snapshots, and VM traces, indicating its role in representing ANR data within the bug reporting tool.

classes.name: Anr
classes.description: Class representing an ANR event, including process info, reason, CPU snapshots, and VM traces.
